lines.en: Creeping silently, following your every move.
Below the depths, Void Walks.
Staring at you until you fade away.

lines.zh: 无尽的注视，让你陷入黑暗。
lines.en: Endless gaze, drawing you into darkness.

lines.zh: 虚空中的猎手，悄无声息。
lines.en: Hunter of the void, silent and unseen.

lines.zh: 黑暗中飘荡，无形却致命。
lines.en: Drifting in the darkness, formless and deadly.

lines.zh: 凝视深渊，失明即坠入梦魇。
lines.en: Look into the abyss, blindness leads to nightmare.

lines.zh: 凝视者，虚空之中的隐者。
lines.en: Void Watcher, the hidden among the void.

lines.zh: 虚无的低语，引领你走向黑暗。
lines.en: Whispers of the void, guiding you to darkness.

lines.zh: 静默的威胁，无声的恐惧。
lines.en: Silent threat, nameless fear.

lines.zh: 骨荒原上，一步不留痕迹。
lines.en: Across the bone wastes, I leave no trace.

lines.zh: 贴着洞穴岩壁滑行，悄无声息。
lines.en: I slide along the cave wall without a sound.

lines.zh: 虚空洞穴深处，永恒的守望。
lines.en: In the depths of the void, eternal watch.

lines.zh: 静默中等待，等待你的灵魂。
lines.en: In silence, waiting for your soul.

lines.zh: 腐骨是它的晚餐，虚空是它的家。
lines.en: Corrupted bones are its meal, the void its home.

lines.zh: 注视着无尽的黑暗，永不疲倦。
lines.en: Staring into endless darkness, never tiring.

lines.zh: 它栖息于虚空，等待着猎物。
lines.en: It rests in the void, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 虚空的守卫，永恒的守夜人。
lines.en: Guardian of the void, eternal night watch.

lines.zh: 梦魇的预兆，虚无的召唤。
lines.en: Boding nightmares, the call of the void.

lines.zh: 注视着你，直到你遗忘一切。
lines.en: Staring at you until you forget all.

lines.zh: 虚空之中的守望者，沉默的守护者。
lines.en: Watcher of the void, silent guardian.

lines.zh: 凝视者，你无法理解的存在。
lines.en: Void Watcher, existence beyond comprehension.

lines.zh: 虚空透镜在体内缓缓转动。
lines.en: The void lens turns slowly inside me.

lines.zh: 失落文明的残响在耳边回荡。
lines.en: Echoes of a lost civilization ring in my ears.

lines.zh: 梦魇在洞穴外打转，进不来。
lines.en: Nightmares circle outside the cave, unable to enter.

lines.zh: 数着骨堆，等下一个凝视者。
lines.en: I count the bone piles and wait for the next watcher.
You cannot escape my gaze.
Staring at you until you break.

lines.zh: 注视着你，陷入梦境的边缘。
lines.en: Staring at you, on the edge of dreams.

lines.zh: 你已经被注视，无法逃避。
lines.en: You have been seen, cannot escape.
Void Watcher, your nightmare stare.
Staring at you until you go mad.
You are falling into the void.
Watcher, you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 注视着你，直到你灵魂出窍。
lines.en: Staring at you until your soul leaves.
You are trapped in the void's gaze.

lines.zh: 我的视线落下，你眼前只剩黑。
lines.en: My gaze falls, and only black remains before you.

lines.zh: 别移开眼，移开就再也看不见。
lines.en: Do not look away; if you do, you never see again.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的瞬间，我已换了位置。
lines.en: In the blink of your eye, I have moved.

lines.zh: 抬起眼，你就忘了来时的路。
lines.en: Look up, and you forget the way you came.
My gaze weighs heavier than the dark.

lines.zh: 你看见我，我也看见你的恐惧。
lines.en: You see me, and I see your fear.

lines.zh: 失明不是诅咒，是我的问候。
lines.en: Blindness is not a curse, it is my greeting.

lines.zh: 盯住我，你的梦就开始腐烂。
lines.en: Keep watching, and your dreams begin to rot.

lines.zh: 这洞穴里没有第二双眼睛。
lines.en: There is no second pair of eyes in this cave.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔正在为我缩小。
lines.en: Your pupils are narrowing for me.

lines.zh: 虚空之力侵蚀着我的皮肉。
lines.en: Void force eats at my flesh.
Rot seeps into my bones.
Corrupted bone surrounds my wounds.
Void breaths pain into me.
Darkness drains my life.
Rotting power shakes me.

lines.zh: 虚无之力撕裂我的皮肤。
lines.en: Void tears at my skin.
Corrupted bone pierces my flesh.

lines.zh: 虚无之力侵蚀我的灵魂。
lines.en: Void eats at my soul.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出黑水，我退了半步。
lines.en: Black water seeps from the wound; I step back.
You are drawn to my gaze.
Gaze upon me, fall into the abyss.
My gaze will make you lose your way.
Stare into me, and nightmares follow.
My gaze will blind you.
Look upon me, with no end.
You cannot resist my gaze.
Stare at me, fall into the void.
I watch you, you are trapped.
You are trapped by my gaze.
The void cave is my bedroom.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛被我碰了一下。
lines.en: My gaze just brushed yours.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我脚边的骨片。
lines.en: You crushed the bone shards at my feet.
You disturbed my peace.
I will not tolerate you.
Stay away, or you die.
You touched my tendrils.
You crossed the line, I will retaliate.
Do not approach, or you will regret it.

lines.zh: 这块骨头圈是我的界线。
lines.en: This ring of bones marks my boundary.
We are suited for each other.
Share the long nights together.
Our souls are entwined.
We guard the void together.
Dance with me, let the stars be our witness.

lines.zh: 我们的凝视会更加强大。
lines.en: Our gaze will be stronger together.
Our union is eternal.
Gaze into each other, and your souls will connect.

lines.zh: 我们的凝视将创造奇迹。
lines.en: Our gaze will create miracles.
Let's protect together.
The corrupted bone glows cold.

lines.zh: 虚空透镜闪烁着诡异光芒。
lines.en: The lens glows with eerie light.
A gift from the Void Watcher.
The bone is ice-cold to the touch.
Dim light from the void.
A gift from the Void Watcher.
The bone holds power.
The bone glows faintly.
A legacy of the Void Watcher.
Faint light within the bone.
You are being watched by the Void Watcher.

lines.zh: 盯久了，你的眼前会发黑。
lines.en: Stare too long and your sight goes black.
The Void Watcher notices you.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，就再也转不开。
lines.en: You looked at me, and now you can't look away.

lines.zh: 你一看我，眼前就只剩黑。
lines.en: Look at me and everything goes black.
You are in the Void Watcher's sight.
It will keep its eye on you.

lines.zh: 你进入了虚视者的视野。
lines.en: You are within the Void Watcher's sight.
My eyes aren't on my face.
Your position has been discovered.

lines.zh: 你的脚步惊动了骨荒原。
lines.en: Your footsteps disturb the bone wastes.

lines.zh: 虚空的标签，已贴在你身上。
lines.en: The void has already tagged you.

lines.zh: 你的体温，在洞穴里发亮。
lines.en: Your warmth glows in this cave.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你走不回去了。
lines.en: From this moment, you cannot walk back.

lines.zh: 你每次吸气，我都数到了。
lines.en: I counted every breath you took.

lines.zh: 猎物名单上，多了你的名字。
lines.en: Your name has joined my list of prey.
Too long a gaze invites nightmares.
Staring too long is dangerous.

lines.zh: 注视它太长时间会有后果。
lines.en: Staring for too long has consequences.
Stare too long and you will go blind.
Its gaze is terrifying.
Do not stare at it too long.
Its gaze can invoke nightmares.

lines.zh: 注视得太久会让你昏迷。
lines.en: Stare too long and you will faint.

lines.zh: 凝视太长时间会让你窒息。
lines.en: Stare too long and you will suffocate.
Stare too long and you will lose yourself.

lines.zh: 再看三息，梦魇就到你身后。
lines.en: Three breaths more, and the nightmare is behind you.
Your gaze has begun to tremble.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的那一下，我就动了。
lines.en: The instant you blink, I move.
Do not close your eyes; that is when it comes.

lines.zh: 你的视网膜正在替我记账。
lines.en: Your retinas are keeping my ledger.

lines.zh: 梦境的门，从你的眼睛打开。
lines.en: The door of dreams opens through your eyes.
One more look, one less piece of sanity.

lines.zh: 梦魇在你颈后呵着冷气。
lines.en: The nightmare breathes cold on your neck.

lines.zh: 你已记不清我的样子了。
lines.en: You can no longer recall my shape.
The longer you stare, the closer the abyss.

lines.zh: 虚空之眼闪烁，黑暗降临！
lines.en: Eyes glow, darkness falls!
Stare into the abyss, soul shatters!
Gaze into the depths, you will perish!
Bone corruption, all you can see!
Void breath, consumes all!
Stare into the depths, fear forever!
Void power, controls us all!
In the dream, the Void Watcher awakens!
Look too deep, nightmare descends!
Under the bones, the Void窥视！

lines.zh: 虚空透镜一闪，你的视野碎了。
lines.en: The void lens flashes, and your sight shatters.

lines.zh: 黑潮从我的眼眶涌出来！
lines.en: Black tide pours from my eye sockets!

lines.zh: 腐骨尖刺，从地里长出来！
lines.en: Rotten bone spikes rise from the ground!

lines.zh: 把你的名字从记忆里抹掉！
lines.en: I erase your name from memory!
The nightmare bites your neck!
The abyss closes, and bones crack!
Void rift, Void Watcher appears!
Darkness, Void Watcher awakens!
Bone pile, Void Watcher wanders!
Nightmare land, Void Watcher roams!
Void cave, Void Watcher guards!
Corrupted land, Void Watcher appears!
Dreams' edge, Void Watcher appears!
Dark corners, Void Watcher haunts!
Void realm, Void Watcher roams!
Beneath the bones, Void Watcher awakens!

lines.zh: 骨荒原的裂缝里，我睁开眼。
lines.en: In a crack of the bone wastes, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 血肉平原的尽头，影子站起。
lines.en: At the edge of the flesh plains, a shadow rises.

lines.zh: 失落文明的地下，灯灭了。
lines.en: Beneath the lost civilization, the lights go out.

lines.zh: 基岩下的洞，透出一线黑。
lines.en: Through the hole under bedrock seeps a line of black.

lines.zh: 洞穴顶滴下腐水，我成形了。
lines.en: Rot drips from the ceiling, and I take shape.
The bone pile stirs, and I sit up from it.

lines.zh: 梦境的边界裂开一道缝。
lines.en: A seam splits the border of dreams.
No footsteps, yet I am already here.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吐在这块岩石上。
lines.en: The void spits me onto this rock.
Darkness arrives first; I follow.
Too much light—I shrink deeper.

lines.zh: 虚空的引力将我拉向深渊。
lines.en: Void's gravity drags me down.

lines.zh: 虚空之水吞噬我的灵魂。
lines.en: Void water devours my soul.
Explosion rips at my skin.
Projectile pierces my body.
Magic tears at my soul.

lines.zh: 虚空的饥饿，从胃里往上爬。
lines.en: Void hunger climbs up from my gut.
Lightning rips at my flesh.
Void devours me.
